Prepare complex traditional recipes quickly with kitchen blenders

Meal preparation can be time-consuming, but with a multifunction blender, the hour-long process can take minutes. Whether you are blending tomatoes, pepper, and onions for a rich Sunday soup, grinding hard ingredients for traditional recipes, or whipping up a healthy breakfast smoothie, a blender can make a big difference in the Ghanaian kitchen. Electromart offers a wide range of multifunction blenders from brands like Black + Decker and Philips in Ghana that can easily process tough ingredients, ensuring efficiency in the kitchen. Investing in a robust countertop blender will ensure that you have a truly useful appliance for your daily blending routines.

What to seek in your multifunction blender?

In Ghana, the most useful blender is a multi-speed electric blender with a grinding mill, but here are some features you might want to think about when purchasing your blender online:
  • Motor Power determines what the blender can handle.
  • Jar Material and capacity must be selected as per your requirement - plastic or glass; 1.5-litre to 2-litre jars to 500ml.
  • Speed Controls & Pulse Function for the right texture and consistency in food.
  • Specialised attachments, including a dry grinding mill and a chopper.

We ensure your online shopping is completely stress-free.

Cook your favourite Ghanaian recipe like a chef using a Gas Cooker

[gallery size="full" link="none" columns="1" ids="24560"]

When preparing a Ghanaian meal, precision and speed is of utmost importance. A gas cooker is designed to deliver just that, whether boiling a big pot of banku or baking fresh meat pies. It lets you switch from a hard boil to a gentle simmer in a split second, which is exactly what you need when managing delicate stews or frying plantains to a perfect golden brown.

Electromart offers a range of gas cookers for homes in Ghana, with features that suit local conditions, like sturdy pan supports, thick stainless steel surfaces that resist rust, and reliable auto-ignition features. Our online store and physical store shelves are stocked with the best gas cookers from brands like Bruhm and Beko. These gas cookers come in two types - tabletop cookers and gas cookers with ovens.

Why buy a Gas Cooker?

Instant and visible heat control: You simply need to turn the knob to increase or decrease the heat. Uniform heat distribution: The open gas flame wraps around your cookware bottoms and evenly heats your food. Works with all types of cookware: Whether you are using traditional heavy cast iron, lightweight aluminium, copper, ceramic, or round-bottomed woks, a gas flame handles them all perfectly. Power cuts are not a worry: Modern induction hobs and appliances work on electricity, but a gas cooker does not, making it available for cooking even during dumsor.

Inverter AC: Smarter Cooling That Pays for Itself

Electromart Ghana stocks a full lineup of inverter air conditioner units built for homes and offices that want steady cooling without a steady climb in electricity bills. Each unit adjusts its power output to match the room instead of switching on and off at full blast. This is exactly why an inverter AC costs less to run over time than a standard split unit.

Why an Inverter AC Makes Sense in Ghana

With inverter AC technology, the compressor stays on and simply adjusts its speed, holding the room at a steady temperature without the constant power spikes. That difference shows up directly on the electricity bill, typically dropping compared to conventional units.

For homes and offices dealing with Ghana's tariffs, an energy-saving AC isn't a nice-to-have. It's the smarter long-term buy, and most units recover their extra upfront cost within one to three years of use.Electromart Ghana carries the best inverter AC options from Bruhm, LG, and Samsung, ready for nationwide delivery, with warranty support and good after-sales service. Most models come with a remote-controlled thermostat, adjustable fan speeds, and a sleep mode that dials cooling back gradually overnight. Several units in the Electromart lineup add WiFi connectivity for app-based control from anywhere in the house. Some air conditioners even work in silence to offer a less noisy ambiance. Filters pull out easily for regular cleaning, which keeps airflow strong and the unit running at its rated efficiency for years.

You want to speed up your cooking so you can have your meals ready in minutes? You want something to race against the dumsor? Yes, a microwave is all you need for that. Whether you want one for your modern apartment in Accra or intend to add one to your office pantry, Electromart has a variety of microwave ovens to offer - from budget to premium models; from solo to convection models - and from renowned brands, including Bruhm, Samsung and LG.

Which microwave oven should you select?

Go Solo, if all you need to do is heat, reheat, and defrost. A basic kitchen microwave oven is suitable for quick reheating, is the most affordable type, is highly energy-efficient, and is easy to operate. Considering the price of this microwave, it is a fitting choice for office pantries and homes in Ghana where bachelors and students stay.
Get the Grill Microwave if you love your food to have the right texture – crispy and golden brown. This is the ideal model for a household that loves pizzas, toast sandwiches, and roasted chicken. Buy the Convection oven if you love complex recipes. The convection model will let you reheat, grill, roast, and bake - the whole gamut of specialised cooking techniques combined into one appliance.

Features new microwave models have:

  • Smart Controls
  • Easy-to-clean interiors
  • Cooking Presets
  • Power levels to cook with precision

We make online shopping easy

While you shop for your durables with us online, rest assured that we will deliver quality items. Browse our complete microwave catalogue online, pick one as per your requirements, and complete your checkout securely using your preferred Mobile Money (MoMo) wallet. Enjoy reliable delivery right to your door across major regions. You can also visit any of our 20+ national showrooms to pick up your unit directly.

Split ACs: A Curated Selection for Refined Living

Electromart Ghana carries split AC units from 1.0 HP to 2.5 HP for homes and offices. Whether the search is for the best split AC for a bedroom, an office setup, or an AC for the living room in Ghana, we have a model here that cools reliably and looks right in any room.

Quiet Cooling With Greater Energy Efficiency

The split air conditioners we stock earn a reputation for quiet performance because the compressor sits outdoors, away from the room. That leaves the indoor unit to run near-silently, which matters in bedrooms, executive offices, showrooms, and restaurants, anywhere a hum would be one distraction too many.

Why Split ACs Make Sense for Ghanaian Homes

Ghana's climate stays warm and humid across nearly the entire year, with mean annual temperatures hovering around 27°C and daytime highs regularly climbing past 32°C, based on mean minimum and maximum annual temperatures of 22.1°C and 32.5°C respectively. Humidity intensifies the discomfort further, particularly during the rainy months, when moisture in the air makes rooms feel hotter than the thermometer suggests. A split AC handles this combination well because the compressor works outdoors, away from living spaces, while the indoor unit focuses entirely on pulling heat and humidity out of the room.

Understanding Cooling Capacity

Electromart stocks trusted names built for Ghana's climate: Samsung, LG, Bruhm, Haier, Midea, and TCL. Getting the capacity right makes the difference between a unit that keeps a room comfortable for years and one that struggles during the first hot season. 1.0 HP to 1.5 HP cools bedrooms, home offices, and standard-sized rooms with ease. 2.0 HP to 2.5 HP handles the bigger jobs: an AC for a living room in Ghana, open-plan interiors, and large family spaces that need consistent airflow.

Why Buy From Electromart Ghana?

Finding the best split AC for a home or business shouldn't take all day, and Electromart makes sure it doesn't. Every order ships nationwide, every unit comes with a brand-specific warranty, and the after-sales team actually picks up the phone. Paying is simple too. Electromart accepts mobile money on all networks, bank transfers, and cash on delivery, with installment plans available for anyone who'd rather spread the cost.

Save Money, Power, and Water with affordable Twin-tub machines

Manage your laundry with a budget-friendly washing machine that uses less power and less water - a twin tub washing machine. This semi-automatic washing machine is the most popular in Ghana, mainly due to these practical benefits. At Electromart, you can choose from a range of renowned brands, including Bruhm, LG and Samsung – each offering top-tier performance for every budget level. Our semi-automatic inventory includes highly resilient motors engineered to handle daily workloads while running efficiently on your prepaid electricity meter.

Why buy a twin tub semi-automatic washing machine?

Safe during dumsor: If your area experiences sudden power surges or drops, a fully automatic machine's computer board can easily fry. Twin tubs are far more resilient against unstable electricity. Saves Time: The twin-tub allows you to wash and spin at the same time, saving a lot of time, compared to a fully-automatic machine where you must wait for the entire wash, rinse, and spin cycles to finish sequentially. Can work without water connection: You can simply pour in a bucket of water and let the tub do the washing – a feature which is useful for places where continuous water supply is unavailable.

Simple Online Ordering System with Electromart

We make upgrading your home laundry setup completely seamless. Browse our complete online catalog, compare tub capacities and spinning speeds, and complete your checkout securely using your preferred Mobile Money (MoMo) wallet. Enjoy fast, reliable delivery straight to your doorstep across major regions, or stop by any of our 20+ national showrooms to pick up your unit directly.

description:
Affordable Double-Door Fridges with Big Freezer Space

Want to buy a new refrigerator but not overstretch your budget? Browse our range of affordable double-door fridges at Electromart Ghana for a perfect blend of durability, modern style, and high-efficiency function. Double-door refrigerators separate the cooling and freezer compartments, ensuring that cold air stays exactly where it is needed most. This smart separation keeps your groceries fresh significantly longer.

Cut Your Electricity Costs

Another major factor in picking a refrigerator in Ghana is electricity consumption. Our top-freezer models are built with advanced inverter compressors that actively adjust cooling power based on internal temperatures. Instead of constantly spiking power by turning on and off, they run smoothly and continuously, drastically cutting down your utility bills and saving you money on your prepaid meter.

Key Features of Our Top Freezer Fridge Range

  • Refrigerator with Big Freezer Space: Specially designed to store large quantities of fish, meat, and pre-made family meals with ease.
  • Low-Voltage Startup (Dumsor Protection): Power fluctuations can easily destroy standard appliance motors. Our collection features the best top freezer fridge models with built-in low-voltage protection. They operate safely during voltage drops, protecting your compressor without the extra cost of an external stabiliser.
  • Smart Cooling Multi-Flow Zones: Multiple air vents distribute cold air evenly, preventing warm spots so your milk and vegetables stay perfectly crisp.

description:
Automatic Washing Machine

Looking to switch to a top-load automatic washing machine? The choice makes sense if you want the convenience of simply dropping in your clothes and powering up the wash cycle with the press of a button. Opting for a high-performance top-load washer removes all the physical labour from your laundry routine. With ergonomic top-loading doors, you can comfortably drop your laundry in without constantly bending down, making it an incredibly user-friendly choice for growing families and elderly relatives alike.

Why buy a top-load washing machine?

Fits Anywhere: These top-load washers take up less space so that you can fit them into tight kitchens and dry balconies. Convenience: No bending to throw in laundry. If you have forgotten to put in a garment, you can throw it in while the cycle is running just hit the pause button. Useful features: Comes with Auto-Restart and saves your cycle, picking it up from where it stopped during a power outage.

We make the switch super easy.

We make upgrading your home laundry setup completely effortless. Browse our full online catalogue of top-loading fully automatic washers, compare weight capacities from 7kg up to 15+ kg, and check out securely using your preferred Mobile Money (MoMo) wallet. Enjoy fast, reliable delivery straight to your doorstep across major regions, or visit any of our 20+ national showrooms to buy offline.

Managing daily laundry shouldn't be a chore. At Electromart, we stock an affordable range of twin-tub washing machines in Ghana. Whether you are looking for a twin-tub machine for a small house or for the best washing machine for a family, we have a good range to choose from.

Why Electromart’s Twin Tub Washing Machines are the Smart Choice for Your Home

At Electromart, we don't just sell appliances; we provide laundry solutions tailored to the unique demands of the Ghanaian home. Our curated selection of twin tub washing machines offers the perfect balance of convenience, efficiency, and long-term reliability. Here is why choosing a twin-tub machine from Electromart is a smart move for your household:
  • Adaptable to Your Water Supply: We stock models that take the frustration out of laundry. We sell machines that are engineered for convenience and flexibility; if your taps run dry, they can be manually filled with a bucket, ensuring you can start your laundry whenever you need to. You don’t need high-pressure plumbing or fancy installations to get started.
  • Superior Water & Cost Efficiency: We have machines that help save water. The twin-tub models we sell allow you to control the drainage, allowing the reuse of soapy water for a second or third load.
  • Built to Last: We sell the best semi-automatic washing machines that prioritize simple, straightforward engineering so you aren't left wondering what to do because you can simply turn the dial and let the quick cycles clean your clothes.
  • Resilient against Power Fluctuations: We stock machines built to handle frequent power outages. If the lights go out, the machine simply pauses and waits for the power to return.

Experience the Best Semi-Automatic Washing Machine

Whether you need a heavy-duty cycle for linens or a gentle wash for delicate items, our semi-automatic twin-tub washing machine with spinner options provides the control and convenience you deserve.

description:
Transform your laundry routine and reclaim your weekends.

[gallery columns="1" link="none" size="full" ids="24557"]

Doing laundry can take up valuable time, but the right washing machine helps simplify the task, making your daily chores quicker and more convenient. Whether you are dealing with dusty clothes from the harmattan season, muddy football kits after a downpour, or delicate lace and African wax prints, having a reliable washing machine in your home changes everything.

At Electromart, we have a comprehensive range, from budget-friendly semi-automatic twin tubs to washing machines with dryers, each designed to adapt to the water and power realities in Ghana while also keeping utility bills low. Select from brands like Samsung, LG, and Bruhm as you compare the prices of these washing machines in Ghana. Our catalogue covers every price point and drum capacity.
Choose from a Twin Tub Semi-Automatic, suitable for areas with a fluctuating water supply, a Fully Automatic Top-Loader for convenience and ergonomics, and Front-Load Inverter Machines for the gentle tumble wash and low utility bills.

Equip Your Bathroom with a Premium Geyser for Instant Warmth

Whether you are setting up a brand-new apartment or upgrading an existing master suite, adding a high-efficiency water geyser gives you ultimate peace of mind and comfort at the turn of a tap. Having a dedicated electric geyser for bathroom walls offers the unmatched convenience of a refreshing, warm bath after a long, rainy evening in the city, or during those biting, chilly early mornings of the harmattan season. No more waiting around for the kettle to boil—just instant, soothing comfort exactly when you need it.

Why Choose Our Electric Geyser Range?

At Electromart, our water heating systems deliver top-tier performance tailored precisely to local household needs and infrastructure requirements. When you install an instant electric hot water shower or storage unit from our collection, you get advanced features designed to protect both your family and your wallet:
Advanced Shock Protection: Built-in Earth Leakage Circuit Breakers (ELCB) instantly isolate and cut off power if any current irregularity is detected, keeping you completely safe while you wash. Energy-Saving Thermostats: Smart internal sensors cut power to the heating elements the exact moment your target temperature is reached. This stops unnecessary energy draws, preventing your prepaid utility meter from running down unexpectedly. Multi-Pressure Valve Systems: Masterfully engineered to handle fluctuating neighborhood water pressures smoothly. This makes them the perfect choice for both high-rise apartment buildings and homes running on low-pressure overhead storage tanks.

Enjoy Hassle-Free Online Shopping with MoMo

We make upgrading your home water system simple and completely stress-free.
